lessons.title: Lesson 1: City Vocabulary & Comparisons
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: City Vocabulary & Comparisons.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.term: Double Comparative (So sánh kép lũy tiến)
concepts.definition: The + comparative (+ S + V), the + comparative (+ S + V). Used to show that two things change together.
concepts.example: The bigger the city is, the higher the cost of living becomes.
concepts.essence: Expresses proportional cause-and-effect relationship between two changing factors.

concepts.definition: Amenities: metro line, entertainment center, healthcare. Drawbacks: traffic congestion, high cost of living, air pollution.
concepts.example: Hanoi is expanding its elevated metro network to ease traffic jams during rush hours.
concepts.essence: Key vocabulary for writing Grade 10 entrance exam essays on modern urban challenges.

rules.meaning: The + more / -er + S + V, the + more / -er + S + V.
rules.example: The more you practice listening, the better your English becomes.
rules.essence: Both clauses must start with 'The' followed by a comparative adjective or adverb.

workedExamples.prompt: Combine two sentences using a double comparative: 'You travel widely. You learn a lot of things.'
steps: Bước 1: Chuyển 'travel widely' thành so sánh hơn: 'The more widely you travel'.
Bước 2: Chuyển 'learn a lot of things' thành: 'the more you learn'.
Bước 3: Kết hợp hai mệnh đề với dấu phẩy: 'The more widely you travel, the more you learn.'
workedExamples.answer: The more widely you travel, the more you learn.

commonMistakes.mistake: Forgetting 'The' in the second clause: 'The older he gets, more wise he is.'
commonMistakes.why: Both clauses must begin with 'The': 'The older he gets, the wiser he becomes.'
